coverage_column: Pr. and prob- ably Bur. and N.

text: PIE *kat-2 ‘to bear young; animal cub’ (p. 790)  — Pog. kaṭla ‘goats’  [Comment: ]
PIE *kamp- ‘bend (of terrain; to curve, arch’ (p. 793)  — Bng. kũpɔ1 ‘corner’  [Comment: ]
PIE *ḱās-, ḱəs- ‘reprimand’ (p. 789)  — Bashg. kās- ‘to com- plain’  [Comment: ]
PIE *kau(k)- ‘cry out’ (p. 753)  — Mult. kūkan ‘to cry out’  [Comment: ]
PIE *ḱuh1ro- ‘strong; hero’ (p. 127)  — Bng. kurɔ, kuru2 ‘strong; hero’  [Comment: somewhat doubtful ]
PIE *kr̥nom ‘cherry’ (p. 796)  — Kann. krūn ‘bird cherry’  [Comment: chance resem- blance? ]
PIE *keu(hx)- ‘curve; crooked’ extended  — Bhaṭ. kòl ‘bent, crooked’  [Comment: ]
PIE *kehau- ‘hollow out’ + - l- (p. 793)  — Ind. kùlī ‘testicle’  [Comment: also OIA ]
PIE *kenk- ‘hunger’ (p. 789)  — Bng. kɔ̃kiṇɔ ‘to be very hun- gry’  [Comment: ]
PIE *ker- ‘caw’ (p. 354(a), p. 567(b))  — Ind. xārúis ‘spu- tum’(a), Rj. kurṇābo ‘to moan’(b)  [Comment: ]
PIE *kerə-, *kūrd- ‘burn’ (p. 768)  — Bng. kurdāṇɔ ‘to fire smith’s hearth’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *kers- ‘a kind of colour (black)’ (p. 767)  — Kal. kreš ‘mud’  [Comment: ]
PIE *kel- ‘prick’ (p. 788)  — Jaun. kɔlli ‘big tree with thor√ny leaves’  [Comment: ]
PIE ?*kóris ‘± biting insect’ (p. 750)  — Bng. kɔrkɔ ‘a tick’  [Comment: quite un- certain ]
PIE *gȗerhx- ‘praise’ (p. 799)  — Rj. gīrbo ‘to begin to sing’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *gȗel(s)- ‘well up, flow’ (p. 798)  — gaṣ, gōṣ ‘stream, river’  [Comment: OIA Dhātup.? ]
PIE *ǵʰai-sós ‘spear’ (p. 126)  — Deog. gesṛi ‘stick for fighting’  [Comment: (OIA), Cl., Germ. ]
PIE *gʰegʰ- ‘to curve, bend’ (p. 800)  — Kal. gúṅgur ‘hollow’  [Comment: very doubtful ]
PIE *ǵʰehaw- ‘gape’ (p. 746)  — Ko.kaṇ. ghol ‘cave’  [Comment: with -l- ext.: Gr., Germ. ]
PIE *ǵʰengʰ- ‘step’ (p. 797)  — Bng. gɔ̀ṅgɔtɔ ‘fluttering of a bird’  [Comment: (OIA) ]
PIE *ǵʰȗel ‘to bend, swerve’ (p. 802)  — jɛḷi ‘performer of a dan- gerous ritual’  [Comment: ]
PIE *tag-/teg- ‘touch’ or  — Bng. tɔkṇɔ ‘to seize forcefully’  [Comment: ]
PIE *telh2- ‘raising’ (p. 228)  — Bng. tulkaɔṇɔ ‘to rise as water’  [Comment: OIA1 ]
PIE *trep- ‘trip, step’ (p. 352)  — Bng. ṭɔpṇɔ ‘to cross’  [Comment: OIA2 ]
PIE *trep- ‘turn away (ashamed)’ (p. 352)  — Kal. tróik ‘to cry’  [Comment: see prec. entry ]
PIE *dens- ‘teach, inculcate a skill’ (p. 809)  — Kal. duník ‘to plan’  [Comment: uncertain ]
PIE *dʰerə-gʰ- i.a. ‘bad weather’ (p. 612)  — Paš. drūũg, drūũ̄g- ‘to thunder’  [Comment: doubtful ]
PIE *dʰeub- ‘deep’, *dʰumb- ‘pit, depression’ (p. 809)  — Deog. dūmɔ̄ṇ ‘flat alpine pasture’  [Comment: ]
PIE *d g er- ‘flow (away)’ (p. 457)  — Him. ghārā ‘waterfall’  [Comment: OIA4 ]
PIE *dʰwerhx- ‘harm’ (p. 620)  — Bng. ḍă̄̀ḷɔ dennɔ ‘to ‘adjudge’ a defeat’  [Comment: (?), OIA5 ]
PIE *nant- ‘combat’ (p. 811)  — Deog. nāndiɔṇɔ ‘to chal- lenge s.o.’  [Comment: ]
PIE *nes- ‘to return home (safely)’ (p. 640)  — Chin. nisbā ‘to arrive’  [Comment: (OIA) ]
PIE *paus- ‘let go’  — Kho. petshík ‘throw away’  [Comment: OIA *pusati ]
PIE *pilos, pulos ‘single hair’ (p. 131)  — Kal. pilésk ‘rug of woven goat hair’  [Comment: OIA pulastí- ]
PIE *putós ‘vulva’ (p. 667)  — Tor.cail. phōt ‘female genital organ’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *pleha-, *plehanos flat, thin’ (p. 812)  — Deog. pɔḷaɔṇõ ‘to beat s.th. flat and broad’  [Comment: ]
PIE *b( )a mb( )- ‘be thick’ and/or *bʰ(e)u- ‘blow, swell’ (onomat.) (p. 827)  — Paš. bumbˈūk ‘bud’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *bʰar- ‘projection’ (p. 829 and p. 110)  — Bng. bɔ̀rsɔ ‘goose pim- ples’  [Comment: ]
PIE *bʰerem-1 ‘stick out; edge, hem’ (p. 836)  — Kal. brom-bọ́-yak ‘single grape’  [Comment: ]
PIE *bʰel- ‘swell; bloom’ (p. 835)  — Pr. bul’ū ‘thick, fat’  [Comment: uncertain ]
PIE *bʰel-(n)- ‘blow’ (p. 830) − *bhelǵʰ- ‘swell’ (p. 830)  — Bng. bɔlgiṇɔ2 ‘to blow (air)’ − Deog. bilgi ‘cal- lus’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *bʰes- ‘blow’ (p. 830)  — Bng. bɔ̀sṇɔ2 ‘to blow (as wind)’  [Comment: OIA?, Gr.? ]
PIE *bʰleg- ‘burn’ (p. 829)  — Bng. bɔ̀lkaṇɔ ‘to have a burning heart’  [Comment: ]
PIE *bʰrēu-, bʰrū ‘edge’ (< * bher- ‘to strike (through), split’) (p. 836)  — K. bēr ‘edge of field’  [Comment: quite un- certain ]
PIE *meigʰ-, meik- ‘close the eyes’ (p. 842)  — Klm. ečämik ‘blink of eyes’  [Comment: (OIA) ]
PIE *men-2 ‘to tread’ (p. 840)  — Kal. brúndik ‘to grind s.th. with one’s teeth’  [Comment: (OIA) ]
PIE *mend- ‘suck(le; young suckling animals’ (p. 842)  — Rj.mal. mēmna ‘kid of goat’  [Comment: much contami- nation ]
PIE *yu- ± ‘shout (for joy)’ (p. 864)  — Kal. húi dyek ‘to howl like a wolf’  [Comment: ]
PIE *reig-(?), reiǵ-(?) ‘to bind’ (p. 845)  — Bng. rɔigaṇɔ ‘to bundle sheaves’  [Comment: ]
PIE *reibʰ- ‘to resound’(?) (p. 846)  — Garh. rabṛāṭ ‘slip of the tongue’  [Comment: doubtful ]
PIE *reu- ‘buzzing’ (p. 846)  — Garh. rum(a)ṇāṇ ‘to buzz as honey-bee’  [Comment: (OIA) ]
PIE *lek- ‘tear to pieces’ (p. 852)  — Bng. likroṛṇɔ ‘to tear to pieces’  [Comment: ]
PIE *legʰ- ‘lie’ (p. 777)  — Bng. legaṇɔ ‘to lull a baby to sleep’  [Comment: tangled evidence ]
PIE *lep- ‘peel’ (p. 853)  — Mult. lāpan ‘to cut the ears of jawār’  [Comment: ]
PIE *leha- ‘complain’ (p. 852)  — Bur. luleéś- ét- ‘to lament and mourn’  [Comment: ]
PIE *weng- ‘bend’ (p. 834)  — Medieval Ku. buṅg ‘hill- top fort’  [Comment: ]
PIE *wes- ‘press, oppress’ (p. 831)  — M. vasvasṇẽ ‘to storm at angrily’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *wreg- ‘to drag, push, (p. 847)  — Bng. rèkṇɔ ‘to press s.o.’  [Comment: (OIA) ]
PIE *sengȗʰ- ‘to sing’ (p. 860)  — P. sāgṇū ‘an expounder of omens’  [Comment: MIA? ]
PIE *ser- ‘line up’ (p. 235)  — serai(ɔ) ‘in a straight line’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *ser- ‘protect’ (p. 236)  — Garh. sāru ‘protective tantric rite’  [Comment: AV and later ]
PIE *seh1 ‘sow’ (p. 862)  — WPah. sōhāṛi ‘maize sowing songs’  [Comment: uncertain ]
PIE *(s)keu(hx)-ḱ- ‘cover, wrap’ (p. 111) (s)keud- ‘to shoot, im- pel’ (p. 802)  — khāsürü ‘the globular part of the skull’ čhụ̃ hik ‘to ride  [Comment: somewhat doubtful ]
PIE *(s)ker- ‘cut off’ (p. 572 and p. 123)  — Ku. khapir ‘fragment’  [Comment: ]
PIE *(s)ker- ‘to cut’ x *sker- ‘±hop about’ (p. 857, p. 123)  — Ind. ašārpʌ́kʰ ‘cicada’  [Comment: ]
PIE *(s)ker- ‘to shrink, dry out’ (p. 859)  — Kal. šaráv ‘dried up’  [Comment: ]
PIE *sker-d- ‘cacāre (719)  — Kal. čirí ‘hardened manure’  [Comment: chance similarity? ]
PIE *(s)kerb(ʰ)- ‘turn; curve’ (790)  — Kal. kap ‘wrinkle, crease, fold’  [Comment: ]
PIE *(s)kel- ‘owe, be guilty’  — Bng. poet. kɔḷu ‘a big sin’  [Comment: ]
PIE *skel- ‘dry out’ (p. 123)  — Kal. čhiáik ‘to dry up’  [Comment: ]
PIE *skeubʰ- ‘push away (p. 860)  — Kal. ṣúpik ‘to frighten away’  [Comment: ]
PIE *(s)tegʰ-, *stengʰ- ‘to sting; s.th. pointed’ (p. 803)  — K. thoṅ ‘mountain peak’  [Comment: uncertain ]
PIE *(s)teu-g- ‘push’ (p. 135)  — Kal. istóṅgas kárik ‘make sa- cred, sacrifice’?  [Comment: related with OIA TUJ (TOJ) ]
PIE *(s)pel- ‘say aloud, re- cite’ (816)  — Pr. pul- ‘say, speak’  [Comment: IA? ]
PIE **spleḱ- ‘plaiting’ (side- form of PIE *pleḱ-) (142)  — Kal. iṣpáẓik ‘to comb’  [Comment: ]
PIE *srenk- ‘snore’ (p. 863)  — Kal. sriṅk kárik ‘to blow one’s nose’  [Comment: ]
PIE *h2eu(hx)s- ‘scoop’ (p. 779)  — Bng. ɔisṇɔ ‘to smear butter on bread’  [Comment: (?) ]
PIE *h2/3osp- ‘aspen’ (p. 783)  — Kal. íspin ‘a kind of hardwood tree’  [Comment: uncertain ]
PIE *h2rǵipió- ‘eagle’ (p. 853)  — Kho. yúruž ‘hawk; fal- con’  [Comment: could also be OIA but looks unlikely ]
PIE *haed-bʰer- ‘sacrifice’17 (p. 230)  — Ku. bhairāṭ ‘(animal) sacrifice’  [Comment: OIA, Av.2 ]
PIE *hael- ‘grow’ (p. 780)  — Bng. ɔ̀ḷṇɔ1 ‘to aerate a field’  [Comment: OIA? ]
PIE *hxorki- ‘tick’ (p. 785)  — Bng. ērkɔ ‘louse, flea’  [Comment: Arm., Blt. ]
